categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Henlius Biotech, Inc. primarily engages in the research and development (R&D), production, and sale of monoclonal antibody (mAb) drugs and related technical services. The company also provides technology transfer and consultation services related to its proprietary technologies. Its product portfolio includes biosimilars, innovative monoclonal antibodies, antibody-drug conjugates (ADC), fusion proteins, multi-specific antibodies, and small molecule drugs.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced biopharmaceutical platforms including monoclonal antibody technology, antibody-drug conjugates (ADC), fusion proteins, and multi-specific antibodies. It employs deep data and biocomputing accelerated molecular design technology, network biology, and polypharmacology for drug discovery. Manufacturing is conducted in compliance with international GMP standards, with facilities in Shanghai having a total commercial production capacity of 48,000L, and ongoing expansion projects to increase capacity further.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Henlius serves patients worldwide, focusing on oncology and autoimmune diseases. Its products target diseases such as breast cancer, gastric cancer, small cell lung cancer, non-small cell lung cancer, rheumatoid arthritis, and others. The company’s customers include healthcare providers, hospitals, and pharmaceutical partners globally, with over 750,000 patients treated in more than 50 countries and regions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Mainland China with significant international presence in the United States, European Union, Canada, Australia, Southeast Asia, Latin America, the Middle East, North Africa, and other emerging markets. It has established global clinical trial sites and commercial partnerships across these regions and is expanding its global footprint through licensing and joint ventures.
categories.supply_chain_position: Henlius operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the biopharmaceutical supply chain, encompassing R&D, manufacturing, and commercialization of biopharmaceutical products. It also engages in licensing and technology transfer, expanding its operational channels through acquisitions and partnerships to commercialize in-licensed products.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on innovation-driven R&D targeting unmet clinical needs, with emphasis on oncology and autoimmune diseases. It integrates AI and advanced computational technologies in drug discovery and development. Henlius is advancing a diversified pipeline of approximately 50 molecules across 14 R&D platforms, including monoclonal antibodies, ADCs, fusion proteins, and small molecules, while accelerating global clinical trials and regulatory approvals.
categories.revenue_model: Henlius generates revenue primarily through sales of biopharmaceutical products, licensing income from commercial and intellectual property licenses, and provision of R&D services. The company also earns income from joint development agreements and technology transfer. Revenue recognition is based on product sales, milestone achievements, and service delivery over time or at points in time as per contract terms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Henlius is positioned as a leading innovative biopharmaceutical company in Mainland China with growing international recognition. It competes in the global biosimilar and innovative biologics markets, with core products approved in major markets including the US, EU, and China. The company collaborates with global partners such as Abbott, Accord, Organon, and Dr. Reddy’s to enhance its competitive positioning and market penetration.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended 31 December 2024, Henlius reported revenue of approximately RMB5.72 billion, representing a 6.1% increase year-on-year, and a net profit of RMB820.5 million, a 50.3% increase from the previous year. The company has shown consistent profitability growth since 2023, with a net profit margin of 14.3%. Total assets reached RMB10.6 billion, and the company continues to invest heavily in R&D and production capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Henlius emphasizes providing high-quality, innovative, and affordable biopharmaceuticals to improve patient outcomes globally. Its competitive differentiation lies in its integrated platform combining innovative R&D, large-scale manufacturing, and efficient commercialization. The company focuses on addressing urgent unmet clinical needs with differentiated products such as the world’s first anti-PD-1 monoclonal antibody for first-line small cell lung cancer treatment and biosimilars approved in multiple major markets, ensuring broad patient access and clinical value.
